verdict.rationale: Tailscale SSH (tailscale-docs-26) provides passwordless SSH access by using tailnet identity instead of traditional key management, and community reports (tailscale-docs-7, tailscale-comm-1) confirm SSHing into boxes without manual key setup. However, this is achieved by replacing key-pair generation with Tailscale's own auth model rather than actually generating/distributing SSH key pairs as the story describes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an SSH key-pair generation workflow, guidance on integrating with existing keys, and independent hands-on validation of the exact keyless setup flow.
